title: Seberang Papan
subject: a wife and husband married thirty-eight years, partners in the veterans' mixed-doubles carrom final at an Ipoh community hall, sitting across the board from each other as doubles partners must, where she reads his raised eyebrow before every flick, the opposing pair whispers that they must have secret signals, and on the last board she pots the red queen and covers it on his nod
caption: 1970s West Coast soft rock, a love song in Malay. A warm Wurlitzer electric piano playing gentle sustained chords; a clean fingerpicked acoustic guitar doubled by a jangling twelve-string; a melodic electric bass with rounded tone; relaxed live drums with brushes in the verses moving to sticks and a soft open hi-hat in the choruses; a clean electric guitar with light chorus effect playing a short lyrical solo in the bridge. Warm analog tape sound, soft and wide, vocal close, gentle room. Female alto vocal, warm, unhurried and slightly husky, close to the mic, with a soft male harmony joining on the last chorus. 84 BPM, E major. Tender, teasing and settled. No distorted guitar, no slow-rock power-ballad solo, no modern pop sheen, no synth pads, no programmed drums, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - Wurlitzer chords and fingerpicked acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
Dewan orang ramai kat Ipoh, kipas siling pusing perlahan
Final beregu campuran veteran, meja paling depan
Kau tabur bedak atas papan macam tabur gula atas kuih
Lepas tu duduk depan aku, macam selalu

[Pre-Chorus]
Main beregu, pasangan kena duduk bertentang
Sebab tu aku hafal semua kerut dahi kau

[Chorus]
Seberang papan, kau angkat kening sikit
Aku dah tahu buah mana kau nak jentik
Tak payah cakap, tak payah tunjuk
Tiga puluh lapan tahun aku baca muka kau

[Verse 2]
Lidah kau terjelir sikit tiap kali nak jentik
Baju kotak-kotak tu, kau kata baju bertuah
Dulu kau kalah kat aku, bawah ketapang Batu Gajah
Malam esoknya kau datang, "Jom, main sekali lagi"

[Chorus]
Seberang papan, kau angkat kening sikit
Pasangan lawan berbisik, "Mesti ada isyarat rahsia"
Mana ada isyarat, cuma dah lama tengok
Tiga puluh lapan tahun aku baca muka kau

[Bridge - short clean guitar solo, then soft]
Papan terakhir, buah merah tersepit dekat lubang
Aku tak tengok papan, aku tengok kau

[Chorus - soft male harmony joins]
Seberang papan, kau angkat kening sikit
Aku jentik, ratu masuk, buah putih ikut belakang
Kau tepuk meja sampai bedak naik berkepul
Tiga puluh lapan tahun, aku masih duduk depan kau

[Outro - Wurlitzer and twelve-string, fading]
